programme.title: Saschiz Old Town, Romania
programme.desc: Saschiz, village, and commune, Mureș județ county is located in central Romania. The villages of Saschiz, Mihai Viteazu, and Cloașterf make up the larger commune of Saschiz. Located in the old region of Transylvania, it lies about 20 km east of Sighișoara"&". First documented in the 14th century, Saschiz is known for its medieval fortress and church constructed by Transylvanian Saxons, a German speaker. They settled in Transylvania when it was part of Hungary. The ruins of the 14th-century fortress sit atop "&"a hill overlooking the village. The late 15th-century fortified church has Gothic details and an imposing clock tower. Along with five other villages with fortified churches, Saschiz was inscribed on UNESCO’s World Heritage sites in 1999.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: When Oga wakes up one morning, he's floating in a great pool of water... However it is actually Baby Beel's pee, as it is "urination season" right now in the Demon World. Oga is concerned about the entire city being inundated and humanity's imminent destruction, so he takes Baby Beel to the drug store to buy some disposable diapers. While he's there, a bunch of bank robbers a take Oga, Baby Beel, Hilda and Furuichi (who were chasing after him) as hostages.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: On the back of Oga's fist a mark appears that is proof of his contract with the son of the Demon Lord, Beelzebub... The Zebul Spell. After hearing that the demonic power grows as well as the Zebul Spell the more he gets into fights and runs wild, Oga decides not to fight anymore to avoid that situation. However, Himekawa Tatsuya, heir to the Himekawa Zaibatsu and one of Ishiyama's TKKH like Kanzaki, is secretly plotting to do Oga in himself, and gives the command to his lackeys...

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: "A - Hilda brought back a bunch of toys from the Demon World for Baby Beel. When Oga and Hilda were assemble one, a horrible accident occurs! - B - The Zebul Spell expands when one does evil. So won't it contract if you act like an angel? ...thinks Oga, who uses a Play Doctor toy with Beel as the doctor to try and heal patients. It's time to play Demon World Doctor!"

programme.title: Boo Moon
programme.desc: Casper emerges from a subway station, following a crowd of scared strangers. He encounters a man saying "see the wonders of the moon for ten cents," and offering a sight through a telescope. Casper scares the man away, then uses the telescope to see the moon. He then flies to the moon for a visit. Casper lands on the moon, disappointed to find no man on the moon. He lies down to nap, then tiny moon men emerge from holes. They capture Casper, like Lilliputians did to Gulliver, then place him in a cage on wheels, in which they tow him to the Ruler of the Moon, King Luna. The King addresses Casper as a monster, and treats him as an enemy. Casper playfully picks up King Luna, and the king has him placed in the royal dungeon. A dejected Casper is imprisoned. Then animated trees attack the city of the moon men. The moon men defend their fortified city with flaming missiles. The tree monsters fight back with water, then break through the town walls. When the fight seems lost to the tree monsters, Casper escapes his cage, and helps the moon men. Casper goes underground. The friendly ghost then pulls trees' parts through the moon surface and ties them together, immobilizing the trees. The frustrated trees writhe and strain against the knots Casper has tied. Casper and the moon men have won. Then, and only then, does King Luna embrace Casper as a friend. King Luna knights Casper for the valiant defense of his people. Then all the moon men join in singing the Casper theme song.

Bluto then launches a cruel joke against Olive and frames Popeye. The capper: he replaces Popeye's spinach with a joke can, and runs off with Olive for some canoeing. But Popeye gets the last laugh with an inflatable sea monster.

Bluto does a slow burn through this, finally stuffing Popeye's trophy onto Popeye's head - but the trophy is full of spinach, so Popeye clobbers Bluto.

Popeye sees this, and takes off in a plane, just in time to help her out. The boys get into a dogfight, and Bluto manages to demolish Popeye's plane. As Popeye is falling, he grabs a duck and feeds the duck spinach. The duck manages to fly him up to Bluto's plane, Popeye has some spinach of his own, and he teaches Bluto a lesson. He's deemed to be a special jewel (since he's made of emerald) and is brought to the jewel storage room, despite his wishes to be in the Land of the Toys. He runs away from Queen Tiara's guards, but is caught, and when they test him for authenticity they find he is only a fake diamond, after which he is allowed to live in the Land of the Toys after all. The children return to the surface and say goodbye to Red Lantern.

programme.desc: A man stops for gas on his way to dig for gold. The man at the station tells him what it was like back in 1849 in San Francisco, which we see. A sucker is hauled off the street and sat down at a card game; he dashes off as soon as someone shouts "they found gold in the hills" but others stake claims before he can. He ends up chopping off a cliff, falling down, and landing in the hospital. The doctor gives him news of another gold strike and he rushes out to begin panning. After some more mining gags and a song, we see a montage of more failed gold strikes. Back to the present day, where the storyteller claims to have sworn off gold, until a rider passes through with news of another strike, when he trades the station for the car and sets out after the gold.

Porky leads a charge, but with no support from his company, he runs back and dives under Beans' bunk. After a quick chorus of "You're in the Army Now," a messenger pigeon drops in with news that General Hardtack is being held prisoner. They dash off in a motorcycle/sidecar, chased by another smart bullet, and arrive in the nick of time to dispatch the general's captors. They fly off in a plane and get shot down to end up together in the hospital.

The animals soon develop cabin fever and get restless, but Mrs. Noah has the answer: "Music has charms to soothe the savage beast." His sons find instruments and begin playing; everyone dances. But Harry the hippo dances with everyone but his wife; Noah goes to her, and while she tells him not to mention Harry's name, Noah convinces her that Harry is thinking only of her. The rains end; Noah sends a dove out who brings back an olive branch. They land on Mount Ararat and disembark.

programme.title: A Haul in One 1956
programme.desc: Popeye and Bluto are, believe it or not, pals and partners in a moving company. (Maybe it's because Popeye isn't squinting here.) Anyhow, Olive has made the mistake of hiring them. She hasn't finished packing yet, so the boys, smitten as soon as she answers the door, compete to help her. Once packed, they compete to move more impressive piles of her belongings. Popeye easily wins these contests, even though Bluto locks him in the van at one point. At the end, Bluto socks Popeye into the piano, then into a table; though he hardly seems to need it, Popeye still eats his spinach, then thrashes Bluto.

programme.title: The Mechanical Monsters 1941
programme.desc: Superman battles a criminal mastermind and his robot army.

programme.title: The Paneless Window Washer 1937
programme.desc: On the outside of an office building, Popeye and Bluto duke it out as rival window washers.

programme.title: Sinbad the Sailor 1935
programme.desc: Sinbad battles a band of pirates at sea and on a tropical isle. A giant bird rescues him, and he ends up back on his ship with the pirates' treasure

programme.title: Space Thunder Kids 1991
programme.desc: Three children pilots fight against the Dark Empire on their mission to destroy the universe.

programme.title: Bride and Gloom
programme.desc: Popeye is marrying Olive tomorrow; he's ecstatic. She has a dream of the future, including twin sons who prove to be a real handful. When Popeye comes by the next morning, he gets a frosty reception

programme.title: Plane Dumb-1932
programme.desc: After crash landing in Africa, Tom and Jerry masquerade as Africans in a futile attempt to adapt to a strange environment.

programme.title: Suddenly It's Spring 1944
programme.desc: In this longer cartoon, Raggedy Ann's little girl mistress is seriously ill and needs sunlight to recover. Raggedy Ann sets off on a mission to the sun and other elements to make Winter end early. works a minor miracle, with the help of the elements.

programme.title: popeye's 20th anniversary (1080)
programme.desc: Popeye is being honored for his 20 years of films at a dinner hosted by 'Bob Hope' (several other celebrities are present, like 'Jimmy Durante', 'Bing Crosby', 'Jerry Lewis' and 'Dean Martin'). When called on to make a speech, Popeye instead shows clips from two of his movies. Bluto does a slow burn through this, finally stuffing Popeye's trophy onto Popeye's head - but the trophy is full of spinach, so Popeye clobbers Bluto

programme.title: Aladdin(Mel-O-Toons) 1960
programme.desc: In this adaptation of the Arabian Nights tale, poor Aladdin discovers a magic lamp containing a genie who grants his wish to marry a princess.

programme.title: Felix Doubles for Darwin- 1924
programme.desc: A famished Felix reads an advertisement telling of a large reward for anyone that can give proof for the theory of evolution. He hurries to South Africa via Transatlantic Cable and interacts with the local animals. He angers a troop of monkeys by telling them why he's there (they're offended he would suggest they could be related to humans) and they chase him back through the cable to America

programme.title: China's concert boom: Why Gen Z is filling the stadiums
programme.desc: From packed stadium shows to sold-out performances in smaller cities, China's live music scene is expanding rapidly. Young audiences are turning concerts into a cultural routine: traveling across cities, sharing the experience online and building collective memories around live performances. The boom now extends far beyond the stage, boosting tourism, retail spending and local economies. In this episode of Unboxing China, we explore how concerts are reshaping consumption patterns and becoming a new driver of cultural and urban development.

programme.title: The self-care economy explained: How emotional spending is reshaping consumer trends
programme.desc: For months, Chinese social feeds have been filled with "Lao Ji"- a third-person way of saying "me." What began as a slang sign-off, "Love you, Lao Ji. See you tomorrow," now signals a broader shift toward self-care and emotional self-support. It also feeds a huge market where young consumers are rechanneling budgets toward small, meaningful purchases that support emotional wellbeing. In this episode of Unboxing China, we trace how a casual phrase turned into a cultural movement, reshaping consumption and mental-health talk.

programme.title: Foodwise: Haikou
programme.desc: Welcome to Haikou, also known as the Coconut City! Join Tianran He in experiencing the unique culinary culture and urban character of this tropical paradise. From light and sweet coconut chicken hotpot to refreshing herbal desserts and spicy rice soup - a local favourite, every bite tells the story of the city's laid-back charm and beauty. We'll explore everything from Haikou's winding alleys and mangrove forests, to the culture of its southeast Asian diaspora, so come and discover this magical destination with us.

programme.title: Dazzling Lion Dance
programme.desc: Experience this ‘very Chinese time of your life’. Have you ever seen a lion that radiates a spectrum of colors? On the streets of Zhanjiang, Guangdong, an extraordinary lion dance performance is heating up the celebrations for the 2026 Chinese New Year.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hainan's Four Famous Dishes
programme.desc: The stunning east coast of Hainan in southeast China, attract numerous visitors to travel. The reason that people tend to visit Hianan not only because of the beautiful beach view but also delicious local cuisine in Hainan. Hainan’s four famous dishes is Chicken, duck, goat and crab. In Wenchang, the ancestral home of many overseas Chinese, people could discover the original version of Hainan Chicken Rice and see how local chickens free range on coconut meat. In Qionghai, seat of the Boao Forum for Asia, you may dine on duck and goat, before feasting on crab in the surfer haven of Wanning.

programme.title: Boxing through the Holidays
programme.desc: Staying active during the holidays can be a challenge, especially with all the food and festivities tempting you at every turn. But what if you could sneak in a workout without having to hit the gym? Next, join Lyne Lin and Jason as they show you how to stay active during the holiday season.

programme.title: Foodwise: Xishuangbanna Ep.1
programme.desc: What's not to love about Xishuangbanna? From dazzling night markets to lush bamboo forests, 800-year old tea trees to close encounters with elephants, this tropical city in southwest China has everything, and is where the story of tea begins. Join Foodwise for all the Pu'er tea you can drink and feast on everything from banana flowers to "elephant food"!

programme.title: Saddling up for new adventures with bold neon and traditional ink
programme.desc: This Lunar New Year, horses are set to steal the show as the Chinese zodiac migrates over to a new animal. But for one Beijing artist, born under this very sign, painting these trusty steeds is more than just a tradition – it’s an expression of freedom. Her work fuses explosive neon colors with bold ink lines. So, what drives her to create these galloping beasts?

programme.title: Foodwise: Xishuangbanna Ep.2
programme.desc: Come get soaked at the Dai people's New Year celebrations! We'll check out buzzing street markets packed with barbecued meats and spicy fruits, crash a foodie auction, and even take part in a rowdy competition, catching fish with our bare hands in the river. All this before hiking through an actual rainforest. We're going to need all the good tea and food we can get!

programme.title: YEAR OF THE HORSE Why horses in British and Chinese art still speak to the Year of the Horse today
programme.desc: What does an iconic British racehorse have in common with Chinese ink paintings? Quite a lot, actually. This Year of the Horse, we’re looking at how artists across cultures have captured freedom, movement, and spirit.

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.1
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah climb Mount.Huangshan, one of China's most famous mountains, sampling its delicate green tea and the rich flavors of Anhui cuisine, and explore the region's ancient villages and lush bamboo forests featured in the blockbuster film "Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon".

programme.title: Chinese New Year vibe permeates Beijing museums
programme.desc: As people prepare to ring in the Chinese New Year, Beijing's repositories of culture, history and knowledge are launching a wave of exhibitions that weave together threads of tradition, artistry, and symbolism. From the communal joy of folk celebrations to the enduring spirit embodied in the zodiac symbol of the horse, these showcases offer a glimpse into the profundity of Chinese heritage and wisdom, uniting the past with the present.

programme.title: Echoes of Green
programme.desc: Echoes of Green takes viewers deep into Anji’s bamboo forests and mountain villages, where a new generation of Chinese youth is redefining how to live with nature. Through stories of outdoor sports, forest cafés, tea rituals, and family farms, the series shows how ecological ideals have become everyday choices and creative lifestyles. It is not just about landscapes, but about people — young dreamers proving that prosperity and nature can grow side by side, and that culture gives life to sustainability.

programme.title: Musician keeps Mongolia’s cultural roots embedded and evolving on world stage
programme.desc: Hailing from the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region of China but having spent over a decade in Beijing, Asr blends the soul of traditional Mongolian music—like the horsehead fiddle and throat singing—with jazz, electronic, and West African influences. As a keyboardist and composer in two boundary-pushing bands, NaraBara and Mola Oddity, he’s brought his unique sound to audiences in Europe and beyond. CGTN reporter Yang Yan sits down with the Mongolian artist to explore how his roots have shaped his musical journey around the world.

programme.title: An Echo of Antiquity: The Enduring Charm of Kunqu
programme.desc: Kunqu Opera, the "ancestor of a hundred operas," condenses its 600-year essence. From its melodious and captivating vocals to its elegant and delicate movements, we will explore the unique charm of this ancient performing art and the profound cultural heritage behind it.

programme.title: From bean to cup: The rise of China’s specialty coffee
programme.desc: Pu’er — a city named after tea — is now at the center of another brewing story: China’s fast-rising coffee industry. From mountain farms to urban cafés, a new generation of growers and coffee professionals is bringing China’s specialty coffee onto the global stage. What makes Yunnan’s coffee region unique? How are farmers, industry professionals, and consumers shaping a new coffee ecosystem in China? Join us as we explore how China’s coffee culture is evolving — from origin to cup.

programme.title: Calm, Cool & Cultured: How one local jewelry designer is reimagining the Chinese zodiac horse
programme.desc: As the Year of the Horse gallops into view, a Chinese designer who was herself born in this zodiac year is putting a fresh spin on how we view this cherished beast of burden—one jewel at a time. Shen Li paid Zhang Jilin a visit to explore how she blends her vibrant energy with quiet elegance in her craft.

programme.title: A Vibe of the Village: The Beat of Xiangxi Drums
programme.desc: Experience the vibrant power of Xiangxi Drum Dance. This program delves into the heart of Tujia and Miao cultures, showcasing the rhythmic beats and spirited performances that have echoed through West Hunan's mountains for centuries. Discover the stories, traditions, and raw energy of this captivating folk art.

programme.title: Unbridled: Graffiti artist taps animal spirit to spray city with zodiac energy
programme.desc: As the advent of the Year of the Horse brings a new kind of energy to 2026, Ma Xiao, aka. Max017 isn’t just adding kaleidoscopic colour to a local wall; he’s charging into the zodiac year of his birth with unbridled energy. By fusing ancient Chinese philosophy with the edgy aesthetics of street graffiti, he is transforming urban slabs of concrete into living tributes to the beauty of the horse—all through the nozzle of a spray can.

programme.title: A Touch of Speed: The Art of Wing Chun
programme.desc: Uncover the principles of Wing Chun, a unique Chinese martial art renowned for its efficiency and directness. This program explores its legendary origins, core concepts like the center line theory, and its practical application in close-quarters combat. Witness the subtle power and intellectual depth of this sophisticated fighting system.

programme.title: YEAR OF THE HORSE Zodiac Girls’ New Year Heights
programme.desc: This zodiac year, the ancient idiom "MaDaoChengGong" promises that success will gallop right to your door. Our culture host, Julian Waghann, saddled up to meet some young equestrians whose personal quests might just teach us all how to leap into our own lucky year! Take a look.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hainan's Four Famous Dishes
programme.desc: The stunning east coast of Hainan in southeast China, attract numerous visitors to travel. The reason that people tend to visit Hianan not only because of the beautiful beach view but also delicious local cuisine in Hainan. Hainan’s four famous dishes is Chicken, duck, goat and crab. In Wenchang, the ancestral home of many overseas Chinese, people could discover the original version of Hainan Chicken Rice and see how local chickens free range on coconut meat. In Qionghai, seat of the Boao Forum for Asia, you may dine on duck and goat, before feasting on crab in the surfer haven of Wanning.

programme.title: Boxing through the Holidays
programme.desc: Staying active during the holidays can be a challenge, especially with all the food and festivities tempting you at every turn. But what if you could sneak in a workout without having to hit the gym? Next, join Lyne Lin and Jason as they show you how to stay active during the holiday season.

programme.title: Foodwise: Xishuangbanna Ep.1
programme.desc: What's not to love about Xishuangbanna? From dazzling night markets to lush bamboo forests, 800-year old tea trees to close encounters with elephants, this tropical city in southwest China has everything, and is where the story of tea begins. Join Foodwise for all the Pu'er tea you can drink and feast on everything from banana flowers to "elephant food"!

programme.title: Saddling up for new adventures with bold neon and traditional ink
programme.desc: This Lunar New Year, horses are set to steal the show as the Chinese zodiac migrates over to a new animal. But for one Beijing artist, born under this very sign, painting these trusty steeds is more than just a tradition – it’s an expression of freedom. Her work fuses explosive neon colors with bold ink lines. So, what drives her to create these galloping beasts?

programme.title: Foodwise: Xishuangbanna Ep.2
programme.desc: Come get soaked at the Dai people's New Year celebrations! We'll check out buzzing street markets packed with barbecued meats and spicy fruits, crash a foodie auction, and even take part in a rowdy competition, catching fish with our bare hands in the river. All this before hiking through an actual rainforest. We're going to need all the good tea and food we can get!

programme.title: YEAR OF THE HORSE Why horses in British and Chinese art still speak to the Year of the Horse today
programme.desc: What does an iconic British racehorse have in common with Chinese ink paintings? Quite a lot, actually. This Year of the Horse, we’re looking at how artists across cultures have captured freedom, movement, and spirit.

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.1
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah climb Mount.Huangshan, one of China's most famous mountains, sampling its delicate green tea and the rich flavors of Anhui cuisine, and explore the region's ancient villages and lush bamboo forests featured in the blockbuster film "Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon".

programme.title: Chinese New Year vibe permeates Beijing museums
programme.desc: As people prepare to ring in the Chinese New Year, Beijing's repositories of culture, history and knowledge are launching a wave of exhibitions that weave together threads of tradition, artistry, and symbolism. From the communal joy of folk celebrations to the enduring spirit embodied in the zodiac symbol of the horse, these showcases offer a glimpse into the profundity of Chinese heritage and wisdom, uniting the past with the present.

programme.title: Echoes of Green
programme.desc: Echoes of Green takes viewers deep into Anji’s bamboo forests and mountain villages, where a new generation of Chinese youth is redefining how to live with nature. Through stories of outdoor sports, forest cafés, tea rituals, and family farms, the series shows how ecological ideals have become everyday choices and creative lifestyles. It is not just about landscapes, but about people — young dreamers proving that prosperity and nature can grow side by side, and that culture gives life to sustainability.

programme.title: Musician keeps Mongolia’s cultural roots embedded and evolving on world stage
programme.desc: Hailing from the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region of China but having spent over a decade in Beijing, Asr blends the soul of traditional Mongolian music—like the horsehead fiddle and throat singing—with jazz, electronic, and West African influences. As a keyboardist and composer in two boundary-pushing bands, NaraBara and Mola Oddity, he’s brought his unique sound to audiences in Europe and beyond. CGTN reporter Yang Yan sits down with the Mongolian artist to explore how his roots have shaped his musical journey around the world.

programme.title: An Echo of Antiquity: The Enduring Charm of Kunqu
programme.desc: Kunqu Opera, the "ancestor of a hundred operas," condenses its 600-year essence. From its melodious and captivating vocals to its elegant and delicate movements, we will explore the unique charm of this ancient performing art and the profound cultural heritage behind it.

programme.title: From bean to cup: The rise of China’s specialty coffee
programme.desc: Pu’er — a city named after tea — is now at the center of another brewing story: China’s fast-rising coffee industry. From mountain farms to urban cafés, a new generation of growers and coffee professionals is bringing China’s specialty coffee onto the global stage. What makes Yunnan’s coffee region unique? How are farmers, industry professionals, and consumers shaping a new coffee ecosystem in China? Join us as we explore how China’s coffee culture is evolving — from origin to cup.

programme.title: Calm, Cool & Cultured: How one local jewelry designer is reimagining the Chinese zodiac horse
programme.desc: As the Year of the Horse gallops into view, a Chinese designer who was herself born in this zodiac year is putting a fresh spin on how we view this cherished beast of burden—one jewel at a time. Shen Li paid Zhang Jilin a visit to explore how she blends her vibrant energy with quiet elegance in her craft.

programme.title: A Vibe of the Village: The Beat of Xiangxi Drums
programme.desc: Experience the vibrant power of Xiangxi Drum Dance. This program delves into the heart of Tujia and Miao cultures, showcasing the rhythmic beats and spirited performances that have echoed through West Hunan's mountains for centuries. Discover the stories, traditions, and raw energy of this captivating folk art.

programme.title: Unbridled: Graffiti artist taps animal spirit to spray city with zodiac energy
programme.desc: As the advent of the Year of the Horse brings a new kind of energy to 2026, Ma Xiao, aka. Max017 isn’t just adding kaleidoscopic colour to a local wall; he’s charging into the zodiac year of his birth with unbridled energy. By fusing ancient Chinese philosophy with the edgy aesthetics of street graffiti, he is transforming urban slabs of concrete into living tributes to the beauty of the horse—all through the nozzle of a spray can.

programme.title: A Touch of Speed: The Art of Wing Chun
programme.desc: Uncover the principles of Wing Chun, a unique Chinese martial art renowned for its efficiency and directness. This program explores its legendary origins, core concepts like the center line theory, and its practical application in close-quarters combat. Witness the subtle power and intellectual depth of this sophisticated fighting system.

programme.title: YEAR OF THE HORSE Zodiac Girls’ New Year Heights
programme.desc: This zodiac year, the ancient idiom "MaDaoChengGong" promises that success will gallop right to your door. Our culture host, Julian Waghann, saddled up to meet some young equestrians whose personal quests might just teach us all how to leap into our own lucky year! Take a look.

programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc: In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain. A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever. And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.desc: 'Medicine tonic is not as good as food tonic' - this Chinese saying is a core principle of Traditional Chinese Medicine. It is believed that the right diet and nourishment can cure and reverse the effects of disease, hence considered an inevitable source of natural health preservation. In this Foodwise episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May explore this ancient concept of medicine food homology as they taste their way through different herbs, chat to experts of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) and visit venues that combine conventional principles with modern ideas. Dive deep into the origin of TCM with us as we learn about the harmony between man and nature and its application in modern functional foods!

programme.title: Dazzling Lion Dance
programme.desc: Experience this ‘very Chinese time of your life’. Have you ever seen a lion that radiates a spectrum of colors? On the streets of Zhanjiang, Guangdong, an extraordinary lion dance performance is heating up the celebrations for the 2026 Chinese New Year.

programme.title: Foodwise: Xilingol
programme.desc: The Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region is located in the northern part of China, stretching from northeast to southwest side. In Xilin Gol, the horses, sheep and cows could be found every where. The local cuisines here are so attractive to the tourists, such as the roasted lamb is a traditional local dish. And the fired stone fried lamb is so hard to find if you are not traveling to Inner Mongolia. Have you ever tried salted milk tea? Just join in this visual trip！

programme.title: Boxing through the Holidays
programme.desc: Staying active during the holidays can be a challenge, especially with all the food and festivities tempting you at every turn. But what if you could sneak in a workout without having to hit the gym? Next, join Lyne Lin and Jason as they show you how to stay active during the holiday season.

programme.title: Foodwise: Kunming
programme.desc: Join host Tianran He in Kunming, the capital of Yunnan province in southwest China. Named the Spring City for its perennially good weather, Kunming is one of China's most ethnically diverse cities, something that's reflected in its food: From boozy sticky rice for breakfast, to the famous "Crossing the Bridge" rice noodles, and evening barbecues, there's plenty on offer here. Also, it's mushroom season, and Tianran is taking to the hills to hunt for wild fungi – but he'll need a trusty friend to steer him away from the poisonous ones!

programme.title: Saddling up for new adventures with bold neon and traditional ink
programme.desc: This Lunar New Year, horses are set to steal the show as the Chinese zodiac migrates over to a new animal. But for one Beijing artist, born under this very sign, painting these trusty steeds is more than just a tradition – it’s an expression of freedom. Her work fuses explosive neon colors with bold ink lines. So, what drives her to create these galloping beasts?

programme.title: Foodwise: The Taste of Home
programme.desc: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May eat their way down memory lane across virtual space and different time zones, and embark on a culinary journey at their birthplace. Eva rediscovers her love for a classic century-old dish in her hometown Vienna and introduces Austria's long-lasting coffeehouse culture to Tianran, who also joins her virtually for an evening with friends and food the traditional Viennese way. Meanwhile, Beijing's charming autumn season sets Tianran back in time as he rediscovers flavors from his childhood. His passion for tea might have even started in one of the old tea shops in Beijing's hutongs, recollecting his memories one sip at a time, accompanied by nostalgic meals and a relaxed stroll under yellow gingko trees.

programme.title: YEAR OF THE HORSE Why horses in British and Chinese art still speak to the Year of the Horse today
programme.desc: What does an iconic British racehorse have in common with Chinese ink paintings? Quite a lot, actually. This Year of the Horse, we’re looking at how artists across cultures have captured freedom, movement, and spirit.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoxing
programme.desc: Join host Tianran He in the historic water town of Shaoxing, famed for its yellow wine. Traversing its canals by boat, Tianran discovers why it's said there are 10,000 bridges in Shaoxing, before enjoying the freshest catch of the day. But as it turns out, Shaoxing's climate is also perfect for fermentation, leading to a wide array of unique local foods that can sometimes be both smelly and delicious – and at other times, downright unforgettable!

programme.title: Chinese New Year vibe permeates Beijing museums
programme.desc: As people prepare to ring in the Chinese New Year, Beijing's repositories of culture, history and knowledge are launching a wave of exhibitions that weave together threads of tradition, artistry, and symbolism. From the communal joy of folk celebrations to the enduring spirit embodied in the zodiac symbol of the horse, these showcases offer a glimpse into the profundity of Chinese heritage and wisdom, uniting the past with the present.

programme.title: Celadon Ou Music
programme.desc: Celadon ou music is also called "bowl music.” The reason is that the ancient Chinese word for bowl sounds like ou. The music originated simply as improvised rhythms tapped out on bowls. It was this spontaneity that made celadon ou so popular. Celadon ou music was at the height of its popularity over 1,100 years ago. But with time, it faded from history. At one point, it was even on the verge of being lost forever. After hundreds of years of obscurity, it re-emerged at the end of last century.

programme.title: Musician keeps Mongolia’s cultural roots embedded and evolving on world stage
programme.desc: Hailing from the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region of China but having spent over a decade in Beijing, Asr blends the soul of traditional Mongolian music—like the horsehead fiddle and throat singing—with jazz, electronic, and West African influences. As a keyboardist and composer in two boundary-pushing bands, NaraBara and Mola Oddity, he’s brought his unique sound to audiences in Europe and beyond. CGTN reporter Yang Yan sits down with the Mongolian artist to explore how his roots have shaped his musical journey around the world.

programme.title: Back to the Land: Exploring new life in rural China
programme.desc: When we think of the countryside, what colour comes to mind? The answer lies in Wuxin—Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water—an ancient rhythm that still pulses beneath China’s landscapes. In this programme, we explore how the colours of Wuxing come to life through the traditions of China’s ethnic minority groups. From Lugu Lake’s matrilineal water world and the metal-hued fire of the Yi Torch Festival, to Dali’s earth-driven crafts, Guizhou’s wooden Dong dwellings, and the volcanic winds of Inner Mongolia’s new nomadic life—the Five Elements guide the stories of people reconnecting with land, culture and community.

programme.title: Calm, Cool & Cultured: How one local jewelry designer is reimagining the Chinese zodiac horse
programme.desc: As the Year of the Horse gallops into view, a Chinese designer who was herself born in this zodiac year is putting a fresh spin on how we view this cherished beast of burden—one jewel at a time. Shen Li paid Zhang Jilin a visit to explore how she blends her vibrant energy with quiet elegance in her craft.

programme.title: World Heritages in China: A Journey on Water from Wuxi to Yixing
programme.desc: Water has always been the heartbeat of human civilization, nurturing the cities it weaves through. From the first drops that carved out its waterways to the thriving metropolis we see today, Wuxi’s story is inseparable from the grand canal. This is the story of a city born of water. In this episode, we uncover how the waters have shaped Wuxi’s identity.

programme.title: Unbridled: Graffiti artist taps animal spirit to spray city with zodiac energy
programme.desc: As the advent of the Year of the Horse brings a new kind of energy to 2026, Ma Xiao, aka. Max017 isn’t just adding kaleidoscopic colour to a local wall; he’s charging into the zodiac year of his birth with unbridled energy. By fusing ancient Chinese philosophy with the edgy aesthetics of street graffiti, he is transforming urban slabs of concrete into living tributes to the beauty of the horse—all through the nozzle of a spray can.

programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc: In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain. A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever. And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: YEAR OF THE HORSE Zodiac Girls’ New Year Heights
programme.desc: This zodiac year, the ancient idiom "MaDaoChengGong" promises that success will gallop right to your door. Our culture host, Julian Waghann, saddled up to meet some young equestrians whose personal quests might just teach us all how to leap into our own lucky year! Take a look.

programme.title: FourWheeler (2019)

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky (2024)
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: Geared Up S1
programme.desc: Een 1970 K5 Chevrolet Blazer ondergaat een transformatie met nieuwe lak, interieur en een dieselmotorconversie.

programme.title: MTB Heroes S3
programme.desc: s Werelds beste Braziliaanse MTB'er opent de deuren van zijn huis om te laten zien hoe het ooit begon en brengt ons naar Mexico voor de beroemdste stadsrace ter wereld.

programme.title: MTB Heroes S3
programme.desc: Twee getalenteerde Canadese broers en pro MTB'ers beslutien samen te gaan freeriden en verkennen de afgelegen woestijn van Argentinië.

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S1
programme.desc: Om de basisvaardigheden van de nieuwkomers in versnellen, remmen en bochtenwerk te testen, hebben MotoGP-legende Daryl Beattie en Team Honda Racing-baas Paul Free zowel een vaardigheidssessie als een puntentelling ontworpen.

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S1
programme.desc: Welke deelnemer kan het verst komen op 500 ml brandstof terwijl hij een bepaalde racesnelheid aanhoudt? Kan Glenn de eerste plaats behalen en het mooiste verjaardagscadeau krijgen dat hij zich kan wensen?

programme.title: S1 - "FMX Nomads
programme.desc: Ga mee op pad met Dan Whitby, Samson Eaton en Arran Powley voor een dag in het leven van globetrotting freestyle motorcrossteam Bolddog. Nu de nieuwste gebeurtenissen in hun nomadenplanning ze naar de buitenwijk van Amsterdam brengt, krijgt de crew te kampen met de uitdaging hun show te combineren met drifters zoals Luke Woodham en Steve 'Baggsy' Biagioni.

programme.title: Endurance - 24 Hours at Spa S3
programme.desc: De 24 Hours of Spa is een bijzonder lastige race. Voor Andy Soucek, Albert Costa en Lewis Williamson is het een behoorlijke uitdaging om de nacht door te komen.

programme.title: S1 - "Supercar Blondie: Living the Dream
programme.desc: In Supercar Blondie: Living the Dream volgen we de reis van Alex Hirschi. Ze begon haar eigen vlog om 's werelds meest exclusieve, dure supercars te beoordelen en haar enorme bekendheid heeft ertoe geleid dat ze miljoenen volgers en haar eigen tv-serie heeft gekregen.

programme.title: Car Crews with Supercar Blondie S1
programme.desc: Supercar Blondie gaat in een V12 Ferrari van een miljoen dollar naar Hollywood. In de 'City of Angels' wordt Alex in contact gebracht met de Brotherhood of Racing, een gemeenschap van bestuurders die veilige rij-omstandigheden willen creëren voor amateurs.

programme.title: Car Crews with Supercar Blondie S1
programme.desc: Supercar Blondie krijgt toegang tot een exclusieve McClaren Senna van 2 miljoen dollar en gaat op onderzoek uit om meer te weten te komen over de benderuzies in de SLAB (Slow, Low en Bangin') gemeenschap en ze ontmoet legendarische hiphopartiesten Slim Thug en Paul Wall.

programme.title: Car Crews with Supercar Blondie S1
programme.desc: Supercar Blondie komt in een Lamborghini SVJ roadster aan in Las Vegas. Onder de vleugels van Patrick, oprichter van de Junkyard Pirates, wordt Alex meegenomen in de wereld van de rat rod: het thuis van de Amerikaanse mavericks en outsiders.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S17

programme.title: Health Explored S1
programme.desc: Waarom voelen we ons aangetrokken tot water? Is het enkel een mooi uitzicht of schuilt er meer onder het oppervlak? We stellen de vraag: maakt in of nabij water zijn ons werkelijk gezonder?

programme.title: Health Explored S1
programme.desc: Reis naar Taranaki om meer te weten te komen over het innovatieve surfterapieprogramma, naar Taupo om meer te weten te komen over de band van de Maori met water en andere fascinerende inzichten over onze geestelijke gezondheid.

programme.title: More Curious? S1
programme.desc: Ontdek eetstokjes, koffie, munten, koken en katoen in deze boeiende aflevering, die ook ingaat op dinosaurussen en hoe het voelt om een aardbeving mee te maken – én hoe je je erop voorbereidt.

programme.title: More Curious? S1
programme.sub-title: What do Karate, and Kick Boxing have in common?
programme.desc: Duik in de wetenschap achter fossielen en verken wat moderne sportscholen te bieden hebben. Wat is inductiekoken precies? En wat hebben karate en kickboksen met elkaar gemeen?

programme.title: More Curious? S1
programme.sub-title: What is the Moon made of?
programme.desc: Wat is melk? Waaruit bestaat de maan? Hoe worden potloden gemaakt? Ontdek daarnaast alles over achtbanen, linialen, zeilboten, slangen en meer in deze aflevering van Meer Nieuwsgierig.

programme.title: Space Greed S1
programme.sub-title: Looting The Moon For Trillions of Dollars
programme.desc: NASA is van plan om in 2024 een bemande heen- en terugreis naar de maan te maken. Hoe lang zal het duren voordat een gigantisch bedrijf de grondstoffen van de maan gebruikt om een megalomane omzet te draaien?

programme.title: Space Greed S1
programme.sub-title: Asteroid Mining: Is The Next Gold Rush in Space?
programme.desc: De asteroïden die door ons zonnestelsel vliegen, bevatten vele tonnen aan edelmetalen, gesteenten en veel meer. Kunnen we astronomische winsten krijgen uit het mijnen van asteroïden of is het allemaal een hype?

programme.title: Space Greed S1
programme.sub-title: Endangered Aliens: Will Humans Trash Space?
programme.desc: Sci-Fi heeft het publiek altijd gefascineerd met beelden van machtige buitenaardse wezens die de aarde binnenvallen en vernietigen. Maar wat als WIJ eigenlijk de invasieve buitenaardse soort zijn?

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1
programme.desc: Televisietorens en zendmasten zijn vaak iconische herkenningspunten van metropolen. Vaak zijn het zelfs de hoogste gebouwen van de stad. Welke tien televisietorens behoren tot de beste ter wereld?

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night (2023)
programme.desc: Sidney Poitier and Rod Steiger shine in this classic mystery-thriller that took home five Academy Awards®.

programme.title: Capote (2005)
programme.desc: Author Truman Capote embarks upon a journey to write what will become the book of a lifetime.

programme.title: Dead Man Walking (2025)
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story of a nun's (Susan Sarandon) relationship with a condemned man (Sean Penn).

programme.title: The Man In The Iron Mask (1998)
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio leads a phenomenal cast in this thrilling tale of majesty and Musketeers. When the excesses of France's arrogant King Louis XIV begin to threaten his subjects' very lives, the legendary Musketeers reunite to save their country!

programme.title: Flesh + Blood (1985)
programme.desc: Betrayed by power. Bound by honor. In the battle between good and evil, only the strong survive! From visionary director Paul Verhoeven comes this epic adventure of medieval bravery and blood lust starring Rutger Hauer and Jennifer Jason Leigh.

programme.title: RoboCop (1987)
programme.desc: Classic sci-fi adventure about a cop...part man...part machine...the future of law enforcement.

programme.title: RoboCop (2014) (2023)
programme.desc: In 2028 Detroit, when Alex Murphy (Joel Kinnaman) -- a loving husband, father and good cop -- is critically injured in the line of duty, the multinational conglomerate OmniCorp sees their chance for a part-man, part-robot police officer.

programme.title: Rollerball (1975)
programme.desc: James Caan stars as a rollerball champ in this fast-hitting, action-packed glimpse into a dystopian future in the year 2018 where a brutal, no-holds-barred sport takes the place of war, and murder is just a part of the game! John Houseman co-stars.

programme.title: Rollerball (2002)
programme.desc: Chris Klein, LL Cool J, and Rebecca Romijn-Stamos star in this high-octane thriller as the hottest team in the brutal sport Rollerball. When they discover the league's owner (Jean Reno) will do anything for ratings, they plan to take down the sport!

programme.title: The Mechanic (1972)
programme.desc: In this nail-biting action film, when an aging hitman (Charles Bronson) takes on an eager apprentice (Jan-Michael Vincent) they become an unmatchable team of killers...until the pupil's ruthlessness puts the two on a deadly collision course!

programme.title: Mr. Majestyk (1974)
programme.desc: Cinema tough guy Charles Bronson stars as Majestyk, an ex-con and Vietnam vet, whose efforts to run a farm are thwarted by narrow-minded locals and corrupt cops. But when a Mafia hitman destroys his crop, the farmer's fuse is finally blown.

programme.title: Murphy's Law (2023)
programme.desc: Charles Bronson stars as an LAPD cop framed for murder by Joan Freeman, a vicious ex-con he had put in prison. Going on the run and handcuffed to a foul-mouthed petty thief, he attempts to track down Freeman even as she keeps killing his associates.

programme.title: Kinjite: Forbidden Subjects (2023)
programme.desc: Action superstar Charles Bronson is at his two-fisted best in this gritty thriller about a hardnosed vice cop who is hellbent on wiping out a child prostitution ring after an assault on his young daughter; taking vengeance into his own hands!

programme.title: Cyborg (1989)
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this adrenaline-charged sci-fi thriller as Gibson Rickenbacker, the future's most fearsome warrior. In the wake of a plague, Rickenbacker must rescue the only person who can develop a vaccine and save civilization.

programme.title: Death Warrant (2023)
programme.desc: Superstar Jean-Claude Van Damme is Louis Burke, an undercover detective who is investigating a series of murders at a penitentiary. But when he unearths a shocking secret, he must attempt a daring escape that pits him against an enemy from his past!

programme.title: Double Impact (1991)
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme leaps into dual roles of Chad and Alex Wagner, twin brothers separated after their parents’ brutal murder. Twenty-five years later, fate reunites them and ignites their determination to exact revenge... with two times the pain.

programme.title: Double Impact (1991)
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme leaps into dual roles of Chad and Alex Wagner, twin brothers separated after their parents’ brutal murder. Twenty-five years later, fate reunites them and ignites their determination to exact revenge... with two times the pain.

programme.title: Bloodsport (1988)
programme.desc: In the role that kicked his international career into high gear, Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as Frank Dux, a man who refuses to lose and who might just win himself a place in history as he competes in a full-contact world championship competition.

programme.title: Lone Wolf Mcquade (1983)
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is Lone Wolf McQuade, a Texas Ranger feared by outlaws and respected by other lawmen. When McQuade uncovers a gun smuggling operation, the action explodes, with McQuade wreaking havoc on all those who come between him and the law.

programme.title: The Octagon (1980)
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is back in this action-packed martial arts showcase co-starring the legendary Lee Van Cleef. Norris takes on his adoptive brother and a training camp where terrorists are being taught the secret killing techniques of the ninja!

programme.title: Breaker! Breaker! (1977)
programme.desc: Breaker! Breaker! stars Chuck Norris at his butt-kicking best as a trucker on a mission to locate his kidnapped brother and bring down a corrupt Judge (George Murdock) who may just have played a role in the disappearance.

programme.title: Code Of Silence (1985)
programme.desc: Chuck Norris stars in this turbo-charged thriller that pits an honest cop against two crime lords and his own department. Henry Silva and Dennis Farina also star in a film that explodes with heart-stopping chases and martial arts confrontations.

programme.title: Invasion U.S.A. (1985)
programme.desc: An army of terrorist mercenaries led by Soviet agent Rostov (Richard Lynch) catches America unprepared and makes it into a war zone. Only one man can stem the rising tide of violence: retired agent and martial arts expert Matt Hunter (Chuck Norris).

programme.title: The Great Train Robbery (2023)
programme.desc: Sean Connery plans to steal a fortune in gold from a railroad payroll car and joins forces with safecracker Donald Sutherland and his own girlfriend, Lesley Anne Down, in a series of intricately plotted thefts that will test their larcenous skills.

programme.title: The Taking Of Pelham One Two Three (1974)
programme.desc: A gang hijacks a subway train and threatens to kill hostages one by one until their demands are met. Forced to stall, transit chief Lt. Garber (Walter Matthau) must outmaneuver one of the craftiest and cruelest screen villains (Robert Shaw) ever.

programme.title: Runaway Train (1985)
programme.desc: Jon Voight and Eric Roberts turn in Oscar®-nominated performances as a pair of escaped convicts who hop a freight train, but when the engineer dies of a heart attack, they find themselves trapped, alone and speeding toward certain disaster.

programme.title: White Lightning (2023)
programme.desc: Burt Reynolds stars as a moonshiner who wages war against corrupt police officials in this action extravaganza full of epic car chases, bone-crunching brawls and terrific acting by a stellar cast that includes Ned Beatty, Diane Ladd and Bo Hopkins.

programme.title: Gator (2023)
programme.desc: The Feds want Gator McKlusky (Burt Reynolds) to go undercover to expose local crime boss and former boyhood pal, Bama McCall. When Gator discovers Bama is involved in extortion, prostitution, and murder, the suspense builds to an explosive climax!

programme.title: Death Wish II (1982)

programme.title: Naked Science: How To Avert an Asteroid Impact (2008)
programme.sub-title: How To Avert an Asteroid Impact
programme.desc: Throughout history, the earth has been bombarded from space. Asteroid impacts have caused mass extinctions – including the dinosaur wipe out.

programme.title: Naked Science: Venus (2009)
programme.desc: Earth has an evil twin. Venus. It is shrouded in a lethal atmosphere of carbon dioxide and acid rain. The surface temperature is hot enough to melt lead and the pressure high enough to crush a nuclear submarine.

programme.title: Naked Science: The Great Flood (2009)
programme.desc: Almost every culture on Earth tells the story of an ancient flood – details vary but the basic plot is the same - An angry God wipes out an unrepentant population.

programme.title: Naked Science: Diamonds (2009)
programme.desc: Naked Science follows the story of a diamond from the creation of carbon inside the heart of a dying sun, through to the cutting of a diamond mine in South Africa.

programme.title: Naked Science: Atmosphere (2008)
programme.desc: We breathe it every day, it protects us from solar radiation, controls our weather – it’s the atmosphere. Naked Science takes a trip from the earth to near space to understand how the earth’s atmosphere affects all life on the planet.

programme.title: Naked Science: Anatomy Of A Hurricane (2009)
programme.desc: Hurricanes are one of the most destructive weather events to strike our planet and have the same power as a nuclear weapon.

programme.title: Naked Science: Anatomy Of Tornado (2009)
programme.desc: Tornados are one of the most destructive forces of the planets with winds at 300 miles an hour. They can destroy buildings and hurl cars hundreds of feet through the air.

programme.title: Naked Science: Mars (2008)
programme.desc: Mars our closest neighbor now a lifeless planet – but it may once have had water and therefore life. Naked Science investigates the red planet to learn how it was formed, how it became barren, and ask whether it ever will be possible to colonize it?

programme.title: Naked Science: Death Of The Earth (2009)
programme.desc: The earth is 4.5 billion years old and it is slowly dying. Tectonic activity is slowly cooling the planet – the continents will eventually move together to form a new supercontinent called Pangea Ultima.

programme.title: Naked Science: Making Mountains (2008)
programme.desc: The Rockies. Magnificent and awe-inspiring mysterious, the Rockies are one of the longest mountain ranges in the world. Naked Science investigates the geological processes that build these massive mountains.

programme.title: Naked Science: How To Destroy A Planet (2009)
programme.desc: The Earth is built to last. It is a 4,550,000,000-year-old, 5,973,600,000,000,000,000,000-tonne ball of rock and iron. It has taken more devastating asteroid hits in its lifetime than you've had hot dinners, and it still orbits happily around the sun.

programme.title: Naked Science: What's Wrong With Pluto (2008)
programme.desc: Naked Science investigates the violent cosmological forces that create planets and discover what it is that makes a planet a planet.

programme.title: Naked Science: Great Lakes (2009)
programme.desc: The Great Lakes are sometimes referred to as inland seas; they are the largest freshwater system in the world. Naked Science examines the early history of these amazing bodies

programme.title: Naked Science: The Big Bang - The First Three Seconds (2008)
programme.sub-title: The Big Bang - The First Three Seconds
programme.desc: 13.7 billion years ago there was absolutely nothing. No space, no time, and no matter. Naked Science follows the first three seconds of creation when a speck of light appeared from nothing and rapidly expanded into an enormous Universe.

programme.title: Naked Science: Magnetic Earth (2009)
programme.desc: The Earth hurtles through space protected by an invisible force field, known as a magnetosphere.

programme.title: Naked Science: Saturn (2008)
programme.desc: Saturn is the second-largest planet in the solar system. Storms on this gas giant can cover an area bigger than the United States Clouds of the gas race around the planet at over 1000 miles per hour generating fierce electrical storms and lightning.

programme.title: Naked Science: Super Flares - Could They Cause Mass Extinction? (2009)
programme.sub-title: Super Flares - Could They Cause Mass Extinction?
programme.desc: Superflares are amongst the greatest events of the Universe. These magnetic explosions can release energy millions of times greater than atomic bombs. They produce streams of highly energetic particles which can be highly destructive to life.

programme.title: Naked Science: Inside The Mind Of Stephen Hawking (2009)

programme.desc: Stephen Hawking, though suffering from amyotrophic lateral sclerosis has developed a unique understanding of the universe.

programme.desc: Lumumba’s Africa focuses on the past and current issues affecting the African continent; Filmed amidst the beautiful landscapes of Kenya and hosted by Professor P.L.O.
